'''Pitkth''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing in [[Mos Ila]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Pitkth sold various [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]].
